value.answer: Honestly there isn't one agreed winner. Reviewers are split: Edmunds, Quartz and Yahoo/AutoGuide go with the Toyota Sienna, while U.S. News and KBB put the Honda Odyssey on top. The Kia Carnival Hybrid is also a strong pick, especially if you want good mpg (about 32 combined) and lots of cargo room. What's best depends on what you care about: the Sienna is the only hybrid-only option with available AWD, the Odyssey drives most like a car, the Carnival is the cheapest, and the Pacifica is the one with AWD and Stow 'n Go seats. Tell me your budget, family size, and whether you're buying new or used and I can narrow it down. These are U.S. prices and rankings as of the latest reviews I found.
